terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms are an agreement between you and <todo>legal entity name and registered address</todo> ("Chizzy", "we"). By using Chizzy you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use Chizzy.

who.title: 1. Who can use Chizzy
who.age: You must be 18 or older. We ask for your date of birth before the camera turns on, and a device that gives an under-18 date is locked out.
who.regions: Chizzy is not available in some countries. Do not use a VPN or other tools to get around a regional block.
who.banned: You may not use Chizzy if we have banned you, or to get around a restriction.

what.title: 2. What Chizzy is
what.body: Chizzy connects you with a random adult stranger for a one-to-one video and text chat. You do not need an account. We do not record calls. Read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> to understand what data we handle, including how peer-to-peer calls share your IP address with your partner.

rules.title: 3. Rules
rules.intro: You must follow the <guidelines>Community Guidelines</guidelines>. In short, you must not share, show or ask for:
rules.minors: any sexual content involving a minor, or any contact with a minor of a sexual nature;
rules.nudity: nudity or sexual acts, or intimate images of anyone without their consent;
rules.harassment: harassment, threats, bullying or hate against a person or group;
rules.violence: violence, self-harm encouragement, or illegal goods and services;
rules.spam: spam, scams, advertising, or attempts to move people to other platforms for these purposes;
rules.unlawful: content that breaks the law of India or of the country you are in, or that infringes someone's rights.
rules.recording: You must not record, screenshot or redistribute other people's video without their consent.

tools.title: 4. Automated safety tools
tools.body: Chizzy uses automated tools to reduce abuse: a bot check (Cloudflare Turnstile), on-device checks that can blur video that looks unsafe or hide your video when no face is visible, filters that hide links, handles and phone numbers in chat for the first minutes of a call, and rate limits. These tools make mistakes in both directions. They lower risk; they do not remove it.

enforcement.title: 5. Reports and enforcement
enforcement.body: You can report a partner during a call or shortly after it. Reports and the material attached to them (one image from the call and recent chat lines) are reviewed by people on our team. Depending on what happened we may warn you or restrict your access: a warning, then pauses of 10 minutes, 24 hours and 7 days, then a permanent ban. Automated actions are limited to temporary pauses; a permanent ban is decided by a person. Serious cases, such as child sexual abuse material, may lead straight to a ban and a report to the authorities.

appeals.title: 6. Appeals and grievances
appeals.body: You can appeal a restriction for free from the restriction screen. You can also raise a complaint with our <grievance>Grievance Officer</grievance>.

content.title: 7. Your content
content.body: You are responsible for what you show and say. You keep any rights you have in it. You allow us to process it only as needed to run Chizzy and keep it safe (for example, to review a report).

liability.title: 8. Disclaimers and liability
liability.body: Chizzy is provided "as is". You meet strangers at your own risk and should not share personal information. To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to <todo>liability cap to be set by the lawyer</todo>.

changes.title: 9. Changes and ending
changes.body: We may change these Terms. When we do, we will ask you to accept the new version before you continue. You may stop using Chizzy at any time. We may suspend or end access for anyone who breaks these Terms.

law.title: 10. Governing law
law.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at <todo>city</todo> have jurisdiction, subject to any rights you have under the law of the country you live in.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what <todo>legal entity name</todo> ("Chizzy", "we") collects when you use Chizzy, why, who we share it with and how long we keep it. Chizzy has no accounts. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

ip.title: Your IP address and your chat partner
ip.body: In the default peer-to-peer mode, your video call connects your browser directly to your partner's browser, so your partner's browser receives your IP address. An IP address can reveal your approximate location and your internet provider. If you turn on Hide my IP, the call goes through a relay server (run by Cloudflare) and your partner's browser receives the relay's address instead of yours. Hide my IP may sometimes be unavailable; when it is off, calls are peer-to-peer.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.age: Age check: you enter your date of birth, our server works out whether you are 18 or older and keeps only that outcome, the Terms version you accepted and the time. We do not store your date of birth.
collect.profile: Profile you choose: display name, country, language, gender (used only for matching filters, not shown to partners), topics and an optional photo. These are passed to your partners during a match and are not saved by us after you leave.
collect.signals: Device and network signals for anti-abuse: a random device id stored in your browser, a hash of coarse browser traits (browser version, language, time zone, screen size and processor count), your IP address and the country it maps to, the result of the Cloudflare Turnstile bot check, whether your camera looks like a virtual camera, how quickly calls are skipped, and counts (not content) from on-device safety checks. We use these to stop bots, enforce bans and lockouts, and limit abuse.
collect.reports: Reports: when someone reports you, or you report someone, we keep the report, one image from the video captured by the reporter's device, and up to the last 20 chat lines.
collect.telemetry: Call telemetry: whether the call connected, how long it took, connection type and quality figures. No IP addresses and no content.
collect.errors: Errors and product analytics: crash reports with names, chat text and images removed, and anonymous usage events (for example "call connected") without cookies and without your IP address.
collect.noRecording: We do not record video, audio or chat.

processors.title: Who processes data for us
processors.cloudflare: Cloudflare: content delivery and protection, the Turnstile bot check, and the relay servers used for Hide my IP and for calls that cannot connect directly.
processors.sentry: Sentry: error reports from the app and the server.
processors.transfers: Some of these providers store data outside India, including in the United States. <todo>cross-border transfer basis, to be written by the lawyer</todo>

logs.data: Connection and application logs (connections, IP addresses, matches)

csam.data: Suspected child sexual abuse material and its report metadata
csam.period: 1 year after the report, in a restricted store that can be put on legal hold

bans.period: Length of the ban plus 1 year

ageCheck.data: Age check outcome (18 or older, Terms version, time)
ageCheck.period: While the device is active, plus 180 days

lockout.period: A salted hash and the date only; nothing else

dob.period: Not stored. Only the outcome is kept

chat.period: Not stored, except the lines attached to a report

media.period: Not recorded. A single image is kept only when someone reports a call

telemetry.period: No IP addresses; aggregated after 90 days

storage.title: Storage on your device
storage.body: Chizzy keeps a few items in your browser's local storage: the random device id, a token that proves you passed the age check (up to 180 days), a session token (24 hours) and, if your date of birth was under 18, a lockout marker. These are needed for the service to work and to keep it safe.

children.title: Children
children.body: Chizzy is for adults. If we learn that a person under 18 is using it, we lock them out. For a locked-out device we aim to keep only a salted hash and the date, as set out in the table above, plus anything the law requires us to keep.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct or delete data about you, and complain to a data protection authority. Because Chizzy has no accounts, we may ask for details such as when you used Chizzy so we can find data about you. Contact <todo>privacy contact email</todo> or our <grievance>Grievance Officer</grievance>.

law.title: Law enforcement
law.body: We share data with authorities when the law requires it, and we report child sexual abuse material to the authorities (NCMEC in the United States and the relevant Indian authorities).

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We will update this page and the date above when this policy changes.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.intro: Chizzy works when strangers can trust that the next person is an adult who is there to talk. These rules apply in every call and every chat. This page is also our regular reminder of the rules.

rules.title: The rules
rules.adults: 18+ only. If you think your partner is under 18, end the call and report them as "Underage".
rules.clothes: Keep your clothes on. No nudity, sexual acts or sexual requests on camera or in chat.
rules.minors: Nothing sexual involving minors, ever. We report child sexual abuse material to the authorities.
rules.respect: Be respectful. No harassment, threats, bullying or hate based on who someone is.
rules.violence: No violence or gore, and do not encourage self-harm.
rules.spam: No spam or scams. No advertising, selling, links to adult sites, or asking people to move to another app to send money or images.
rules.real: Be real. No pre-recorded, looped or fake video, and do not pretend to be someone else.
rules.privacy: Respect privacy. Do not record or screenshot people, and do not share anyone's personal details.
rules.law: Follow the law where you are and in India.

enforcement.title: What happens if someone breaks the rules
enforcement.intro: Reports are reviewed by people on our team. Depending on what happened, the steps are:
enforcement.ban: a permanent ban (only decided by a person).
enforcement.outro: Serious cases can skip steps. A report on its own leads at most to a temporary pause until a person reviews it. You can appeal any restriction for free from the restriction screen.

staySafe.title: Stay safe
staySafe.personal: Do not share your name, school, workplace, address, phone number or social media handles.
staySafe.sextortion: If someone threatens to share images of you, do not pay and stop replying. See our <safety>Safety page</safety>.
staySafe.next: Use Next or Report as soon as something feels wrong.

danger.title: If you are in danger
danger.body: Call your local emergency number (112 in India, 911 in the United States).

helplines.title: Helplines
helplines.cyberCrime: 1930: National Cyber Crime Helpline. You can also report at cybercrime.gov.in.
helplines.childline: 1098: Childline, for children and young people who need help.
helplines.lifeline: 988: Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. Call or text, any time.
helplines.cyberTipline: NCMEC CyberTipline: report the online sexual exploitation of a child at report.cybertip.org or call 1-800-843-5678.
helplines.elsewhereBody: Call your local emergency number, or a local helpline for crisis support.

sextortion.title: If someone threatens to share images of you (sextortion)
sextortion.doNotPay: Do not pay and do not send more images. Paying rarely stops the demands.
sextortion.stopReplying: Stop replying, but keep the messages as evidence.
sextortion.report: Report the person in Chizzy and to the police (1930 in India).
sextortion.takeItDown: If the images are of you under 18, <takeItDown>Take It Down</takeItDown> (NCMEC) can help stop them spreading. Adults can use <stopNcii>StopNCII.org</stopNcii>.
sextortion.takedown: If an image of you came from Chizzy, ask us to remove it with our <takedown>takedown form</takedown>.

measures.title: How Chizzy tries to keep calls safer
measures.ageCheck: An age check before the camera turns on. It stops honest children; it cannot stop everyone who lies.
measures.botCheck: A bot check before you start.
measures.blur: On-device checks that can blur a partner's video that looks unsafe. They can miss things.
measures.filters: Links, handles and phone numbers are hidden in chat for the first minutes of a call.
measures.reporting: One-tap reporting during a call and for a short time after it. People on our team review reports.
measures.outro: No tool catches everything. End the call with Next or Report whenever something feels wrong, and do not share personal details with strangers.

grievance.title: Grievance Officer
grievance.intro: Under India's Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, you can raise a complaint about content on Chizzy or about how we applied our rules to you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.officer: Grievance Officer: <todo>name of the Grievance Officer</todo>

timelines.title: Timelines
timelines.acknowledge: We acknowledge a complaint within 24 hours of receiving it.
timelines.resolve: We aim to resolve it within 15 days.
timelines.intimate: Complaints about intimate images of you, or images of you that were altered, have shorter legal deadlines. Use the <takedown>takedown form</takedown> so they reach the right queue at once.

include.title: What to include
include.what: What happened and roughly when (date, time and time zone).
include.name: Any display name you saw, and what you would like us to do.
include.email: An email address where we can reach you.

unsatisfied.title: If you are not satisfied
unsatisfied.body: You can appeal the Grievance Officer's decision to the Grievance Appellate Committee within 30 days at <gac>gac.gov.in</gac>.

lawEnforcement.title: Law enforcement requests
lawEnforcement.intro: This page is for police, courts and government agencies. Users looking for help should see the <safety>Safety page</safety>.

how.title: How to send a request
how.official: Send requests from an official address, citing the legal basis and the authority that issued it.
how.mlat: Requests from outside India may need to go through the applicable mutual legal assistance process.

emergencies.title: Emergencies
emergencies.body: If there is an imminent risk of death or serious harm, mark the request as an emergency and explain the risk. We review emergency requests as a priority. <todo>emergency contact route</todo>

data.title: What data may exist
data.intro: Chizzy has no accounts and does not record video, audio or chat. What may exist, within the retention periods in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>:
data.logs: connection logs: IP address, time, country and pseudonymous device identifiers;
data.matches: match records: which pseudonymous devices were paired, and when;
data.reports: reports: the reason, one image captured by the reporter's device and up to 20 chat lines;

preservation.title: Preservation
preservation.body: We can preserve specific records while you obtain legal process. Send a preservation request with the details above.

csam.title: Child sexual abuse material
csam.body: We report apparent child sexual abuse material to NCMEC in the United States and to the relevant Indian authorities, and we preserve the related records.

takedown.title: Report content for removal
takedown.intro: Use this form to ask us to remove an intimate image shared without consent, sexual content involving a minor, impersonation, or other unlawful content connected to Chizzy.
takedown.noRecording: Chizzy does not record calls. Content we may hold is an image captured when a call was reported. Profile photos are passed between partners during a match and not kept after it.
takedown.deadlines: For intimate images shared without consent, the law (the US TAKE IT DOWN Act, and India's IT Rules) sets short deadlines for removal after a valid request. This form starts that process.
takedown.childInDanger: If a child is in danger, contact the police or the helplines on our <safety>Safety page</safety> first.

kinds.ncii: An intimate image of me (or someone I represent) shared without consent
kinds.impersonation: Someone is pretending to be me
